text:
margo: Starting thread for PR #5109 - migration guide + SDK snippet updates. Need legal + security redaction OK before we hit the Thursday docs release.

kevin: Which parts are flagged as sensitive? I only saw cookie example and an infra snippet.

margo: The infra snippet includes a real cluster name and theres an example that prints an API token in logs. Need both changed.

nina: Proposed edits: replace cluster `eu-prod-cluster-01` -> `CLUSTER_NAME`, and change log prints to `console.log('apiKey=[REDACTED]')`. Also add a short note about never logging secrets.

security: Please add a line to the migration steps to rotate credentials after running the sample. Also remove any hardcoded file paths pointing to `/etc/secrets/`.

legal: We need a redaction statement at the top: "This public guide omits identifying infrastructure names. Internal examples are available on request from legal@redwood.com." Approved once added.

docs-ci: Preview built: https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/5109 sha=de4f90. Linkcheck + linter passed.

kevin: I pushed branch `docs/5109-redact` with the changes and the redaction note. Ready for final thumbs.

margo: Scheduling merge for Thu 09:30 PT in the docs release window. If no objections by 09:00 we'll merge.

nina: +1 from docs. Thanks all.

kevin: Thanks, tagging release notes to include the redaction callout.
